Charming 3-Bedroom Home with Skyline Views and ADU Potential

Welcome to 954 Girard Street, a beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with 1,100 square feet of modern living space. Step out into the backyard, where breathtaking views of the San Francisco skyline create a stunning and serene setting, ideal for both quiet evenings and lively gatherings.

A short walk away, McLaren Park provides trails, recreational activities, and abundant natural beauty, offering the perfect extension of outdoor space. With potential for an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), this property opens doors to additional living space, rental income, or a creative studio. Discover the blend of comfort, charm, and opportunity this home has to offer.
